questions.stem: What is the difference between the apoplast and symplast pathways of water movement through the root?

options.text: The apoplast pathway moves water through the xylem, while the symplast pathway moves water through the phloem
The apoplast pathway moves water through cell walls and intercellular spaces, while the symplast pathway moves water through the cytoplasm via plasmodesmata
The apoplast pathway requires energy, while the symplast pathway does not
The apoplast pathway only works in daylight, while the symplast pathway works all the time

questions.explanation: In the apoplast pathway, water moves through the cell walls and spaces between cells without crossing any membranes. In the symplast pathway, water moves through the cytoplasm of cells, passing from cell to cell via plasmodesmata (tiny channels connecting adjacent cells).
